This '''planet''' was the original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Near-Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] species. At some point in time, however, the planet was rendered uninhabitable because it was unstable and began losing its atmosphere to space.<ref name="TOTJC" /> As a result of the cataclysm, the Miraluka were forced to leave their homeworld and ultimately settled on the planet [[Alpheridies/Legends|Alpheridies]].
